translations.literal: Qianlong year 1, bingchen cyclical year; the Sichuan governor-generalship was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 (bingchen), the post of Sichuan governor-general was abolished.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，以閩浙總督銜專管福建事。 浙江總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiashen: with the title of Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general, was put in sole charge of Fujian affairs. Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the second month, given the Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general title to administer Fujian alone. Zhejiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉雲南總督。 貴州總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiyou: Yunnan governor-general. Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the sixth month: Yunnan governor-general; Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 正月丙辰遷。二月壬申署漕運總督。 補。

translations.literal: First month, day bingchen: transferred. Second month, day renshen: acting grain-transport governor-general. Confirmed appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on bingchen of the first month. On renshen of the second month became acting grain-transport governor-general, then confirmed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯補。六月丙申遷。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: confirmed appointment. Sixth month, day bingshen: transferred.
translations.idiomatic: Confirmed on xinmao; transferred on bingshen of the sixth month.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年丁巳

translations.literal: Qianlong year 2, dingsi cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 2 (dingsi)

sentences.zh: 正月庚子召。兩江總督。閏九月丁卯，遷。兩江總督。

translations.literal: First month, day gengzi: summoned. Liangjiang governor-general. Intercalary ninth month, day dingmao: transferred. Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on gengzi of the first month as Liangjiang governor-general. On dingmao of the intercalary ninth month, transferred to Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰召。湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiachen: summoned. Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on jiachen of the ninth month as Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 四月乙卯陛見。署。九月丁卯，雲南總督。 仍貴州。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day yimao: imperial audience. Acting appointment. Ninth month, day dingmao: Yunnan governor-general. Still also Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Granted audience on yimao of the fourth month; acting appointment. On dingmao of the ninth month became Yunnan governor-general while still holding Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 七月癸丑革。八月丙子署直隸河道總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day guichou: dismissed from office. Eighth month, day bingzi: acting Zhili river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Dismissed on guichou of the seventh month. On bingzi of the eighth month became acting Zhili River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三年戊午裁浙江總督。

translations.literal: Qianlong year 3, wuwu cyclical year; the Zhejiang governor-generalship was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 3 (wuwu), the post of Zhejiang governor-general was abolished.

sentences.zh: 十月丁酉免。署直隸總督。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day dingyou: excused from office. Acting Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Excused from office on dingyou of the tenth month; acting Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 七月丙寅遷。川陝總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day bingyin: transferred. Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on bingyin of the seventh month to Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general.

sentences.zh: 七月丙寅遷。兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day bingyin: transferred. Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on bingyin of the seventh month to Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 七月丙寅漕運總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day bingyin: grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin of the seventh month became grain-transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 改協理。正月癸酉，直隸河道總督。九月甲子被劾。管理總河印務。十月丙午補。

translations.literal: Changed to assistant superintendent. First month, day guiyou: Zhili river-works governor-general. Ninth month, day jiazi: impeached. Administered the seal duties of the overall river commissioner. Tenth month, day bingwu: confirmed appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Reassigned as assistant superintendent. On guiyou of the first month became Zhili River Works Governor-General. Impeached on jiazi of the ninth month; administered the overall river commissioner’s seal duties. Confirmed on bingwu of the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四年己未

translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 4 (jiwei)

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申憂。署兩江總督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wushen: mourning leave. Acting Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the eleventh month entered mourning leave; acting Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 七月丙寅遷。閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day bingyin: transferred. Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on bingyin of the seventh month to Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 七月丙寅遷。湖廣總督。

translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 5 (gengshen)

sentences.zh: 五月甲子免。署兩江總督。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiazi: excused from office. Acting Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Excused from office on jiazi of the fifth month; acting Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌召。川陝總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengxu: summoned. Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on gengxu of the third month as Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳憂。署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jisi: mourning leave. Acting Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of the eleventh month entered mourning leave; acting Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉召。署貴州總督。 仍雲南。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiyou: summoned. Acting Guizhou governor-general. Still also Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on guiyou of the sixth month as acting Guizhou governor-general while still holding Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 十月戊戌遷。漕運總督。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day wuxu: transferred. Grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on wuxu of the tenth month to grain-transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑遷。湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jichou: transferred. Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on jichou of the eighth month to Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 四月戊申憂。署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day wushen: mourning leave. Acting Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the fourth month entered mourning leave; acting Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 四月遷。署雲南。 仍貴州。

translations.literal: Fourth month: transferred. Acting Yunnan. Still also Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred in the fourth month as acting Yunnan governor-general while still holding Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥遷。漕運總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinhai: transferred. Grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on xinhai of the twelfth month to grain-transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉召。兼理直隸河道總督。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiyou: summoned. Also acting Zhili river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on jiyou of the eighth month and also made acting Zhili River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉遷。江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiyou: transferred. Jiangnan river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on jiyou of the eighth month to Jiangnan River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 乾隆七年壬戌

translations.literal: Qianlong year 7, renxu cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 7 (renxu)

sentences.zh: 六月癸未差。署直隸總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiwei: dispatched on special duty. Acting Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Dispatched on guiwei of the sixth month; acting Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 四月癸巳遷。兩江總督。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guisi: transferred. Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on guisi of the fourth month to Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑憂。署川陝總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingchou: mourning leave. Acting Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the ninth month entered mourning leave; acting Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general.

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guisi: transferred. Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinhai: transferred. Jiangnan river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on xinhai of the twelfth month to Jiangnan River Works Governor-General.

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinhai: transferred. Hedong river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on xinhai of the twelfth month to Hedong River Works Governor-General.

translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 8 (guihai)

sentences.zh: 二月庚子召。兩江總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengzi: summoned. Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on gengzi of the second month as Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申遷。川陝總督。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wushen: transferred. Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on wushen of the fifth month to Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general.

sentences.zh: 正月丁巳召。湖廣總督。

translations.literal: First month, day dingsi: summoned. Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on dingsi of the first month as Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 正月戊午陛見。兩廣總督。五月戊申遷。兩廣總督。

translations.literal: First month, day wuwu: imperial audience. Liangguang governor-general. Fifth month, day wushen: transferred. Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Granted audience on wuwu of the first month as Liangguang governor-general. On wushen of the fifth month, transferred to Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乾隆九年甲子

translations.literal: Qianlong year 9, jiazi cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 9 (jiazi)

sentences.zh: 七月戊寅遷。閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day wuyin: transferred. Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on wuyin of the seventh month to Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑遷。湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingchou: transferred. Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on dingchou of the second month to Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 七月戊寅遷。兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day wuyin: transferred. Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on wuyin of the seventh month to Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十年乙丑

translations.literal: Qianlong year 10, yichou cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 10 (yichou)

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯直隸總督。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinmao: Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao of the fifth month became Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 四月乙卯召。兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day yimao: summoned. Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on yimao of the fourth month as Liangguang governor-general.

translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 11 (bingyin)

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingsi: summoned. Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on dingsi of the ninth month as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌召。湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renxu: summoned. Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on renxu of the ninth month as Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 閏三月己亥遷。漕運總督。九月庚子回任。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, day jihai: transferred. Grain-transport governor-general. Ninth month, day gengzi: returned to original post.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on jihai of the intercalary third month to grain-transport governor-general. Returned to his original post on gengzi of the ninth month.

sentences.zh: 閏三月己亥革。署江南河道總督。九月庚子回原任。江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, day jihai: dismissed from office. Acting Jiangnan river-works governor-general. Ninth month, day gengzi: returned to original post. Jiangnan river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Dismissed on jihai of the intercalary third month; acting Jiangnan River Works Governor-General. On gengzi of the ninth month returned to his original post as Jiangnan River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十二年丁卯裁貴州總督。

translations.literal: Qianlong year 12, dingmao cyclical year; the Guizhou governor-generalship was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 12 (dingmao), the post of Guizhou governor-general was abolished.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑召。川陝總督。十二月乙亥，進勦大金川。署川陝總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinchou: summoned. Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general. Twelfth month, day yihai: advanced to suppress the Greater Jinchuan. Acting Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on xinchou of the third month as Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general. On yihai of the twelfth month advanced to campaign against the Greater Jinchuan; acting Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑，改雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinchou: changed to Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou of the third month, the post was changed to Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子遷。漕運總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renzi: transferred. Grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on renzi of the ninth month to grain-transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 四月戊辰差。署直隸河道總督。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day wuchen: dispatched on special duty. Acting Zhili river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Dispatched on wuchen of the fourth month; acting Zhili River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年戊辰分設陝西總督、四川總督。

translations.literal: Qianlong year 13, wuchen cyclical year; Shaanxi governor-general and Sichuan governor-general were separately established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 13 (wuchen), separate posts of Shaanxi governor-general and Sichuan governor-general were established.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午遷。兩江總督。十一月癸酉遷。兼署兩江總督。十二月丁亥，兩江總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuwu: transferred. Liangjiang governor-general. Eleventh month, day guiyou: transferred. Also acting Liangjiang governor-general. Twelfth month, day dinghai: Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on wuwu of the ninth month to Liangjiang governor-general. On guiyou of the eleventh month transferred and also made acting Liangjiang governor-general. On dinghai of the twelfth month became Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉遷。暫護川陝總督。九月戊寅，革。暫管川陝總督。十一月癸酉，川陝總督。庚辰，分設兩督，陝甘總督，四川總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinyou: transferred. Temporarily overseeing Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general. Ninth month, day wuyin: dismissed. Temporarily administering Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general. Eleventh month, day guiyou: Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general. Day gengchen: two governorships separately established—Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general, Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on xinyou of the ninth month to temporarily oversee Sichuan-Shaanxi. Dismissed on wuyin of the ninth month, then temporarily administered Sichuan-Shaanxi. On guiyou of the eleventh month became Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general. On gengchen the two posts were split into Shaanxi-Gansu and Sichuan governor-generals.

sentences.zh: 閏七月己巳召。署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, day jisi: summoned. Acting Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on jisi of the intercalary seventh month as acting Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午遷。兩廣總督。十月乙酉召。兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuwu: transferred. Liangguang governor-general. Tenth month, day yiyou: summoned. Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on wuwu of the ninth month to Liangguang governor-general. Summoned on yiyou of the tenth month as Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 閏七月戊辰逮。暫管江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, day wuchen: arrested. Temporarily administering Jiangnan river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Arrested on wuchen of the intercalary seventh month; temporarily administered Jiangnan River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未遷。河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiwei: transferred. Hedong river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on yiwei of the third month to Hedong River Works Governor-General.

translations.idiomatic: Dispatched on dingsi of the first month as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general while still holding Sichuan.

translations.idiomatic: Dispatched on gengzi of the second month as Huguang governor-general. Transferred on xinmao of the twelfth month to Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 四月戊戌革。漕運總督。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day wuxu: dismissed from office. Grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Dismissed on wuxu of the fourth month; grain-transport governor-general.

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yichou: mourning leave. Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the eleventh month entered mourning leave as Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 正月丁未遷。兩廣總督。

translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 16 (xinwei)

sentences.zh: 閏五月戊寅遷。兩江總督。未任前，兼管。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, day wuyin: transferred. Liangjiang governor-general. Before taking office, also administered [duties].
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on wuyin of the intercalary fifth month to Liangjiang governor-general, administering concurrently before formally taking office.

sentences.zh: 閏五月戊寅遷。陝甘總督。 仍四川。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, day wuyin: transferred. Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general. Still also Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on wuyin of the intercalary fifth month to Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general while still holding Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅遷。湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: transferred. Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on gengyin of the ninth month to Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅卒。兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: died in office. Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Died in office on gengyin of the ninth month as Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十七年壬申

translations.literal: Qianlong year 17, renshen cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 17 (renshen)

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥召。暫署兩江總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dinghai: summoned. Temporarily acting Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on dinghai of the ninth month to serve temporarily as acting Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十八年癸酉

translations.literal: Qianlong year 18, guiyou cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 18 (guiyou)

sentences.zh: 正月戊寅遷。署兩江總督。

translations.literal: First month, day wuyin: transferred. Acting Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on wuyin of the first month as acting Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 正月戊寅憂。遷四川總督。陝甘總督。九月壬申遷。陝甘總督。

translations.literal: First month, day wuyin: mourning leave. Transferred to Sichuan governor-general. Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general. Ninth month, day renshen: transferred. Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the first month entered mourning leave; transferred to Sichuan governor-general, then Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general. On renshen of the ninth month transferred to Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯召。署湖廣總督。未任前署。八月辛丑仍回湖廣總督任。九月壬申遷。湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day jimao: summoned. Acting Huguang governor-general. Acting before taking office. Eighth month, day xinchou: still returned to Huguang governor-general post. Ninth month, day renshen: transferred. Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on jimao of the third month as acting Huguang governor-general, acting before formally taking office. On xinchou of the eighth month returned to the Huguang governor-general post. On renshen of the ninth month transferred to Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 正月戊寅憂。署兩廣總督。九月壬申召。兩廣總督。

translations.literal: First month, day wuyin: mourning leave. Acting Liangguang governor-general. Ninth month, day renshen: summoned. Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the first month entered mourning leave as acting Liangguang governor-general. Summoned on renshen of the ninth month as Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥議處。江南河道總督。九月壬申遷。江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jihai: deliberated for punishment. Jiangnan river-works governor-general. Ninth month, day renshen: transferred. Jiangnan river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Censured on jihai of the eighth month as Jiangnan River Works Governor-General. On renshen of the ninth month transferred to Jiangnan River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十九年甲戌

translations.literal: Qianlong year 19, jiaxu cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 19, jiaxu

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳召。兼署兩江總督。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingsi: summoned. Also acting Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on dingsi of the eighth month and also made acting Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌差。署陝甘總督。 仍四川。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuxu: dispatched on special duty. Acting Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general. Still also Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Dispatched on wuxu of the fifth month as acting Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general while still holding Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 四月辛卯署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day xinmao: acting Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao of the fourth month became acting Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，署江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingchen: acting Jiangnan river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the twelfth month became acting Jiangnan River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥召。河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinhai: summoned. Hedong river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on xinhai of the third month as Hedong River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十年乙亥

translations.literal: Qianlong year 20, yihai cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 20, yihai

sentences.zh: 九月丙申差。署直隸總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingshen: dispatched on special duty. Acting Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Dispatched on bingshen of the ninth month as acting Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 六月召。調陝甘。 調四川。

translations.literal: Sixth month: summoned. Transferred to Shaanxi-Gansu. Transferred to Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned in the sixth month; transferred to Shaanxi-Gansu and to Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑遷。署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guichou: transferred. Acting Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on guichou of the sixth month as acting Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑遷。雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guichou: transferred. Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on guichou of the sixth month to Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十一年丙子

translations.literal: Qianlong year 21, bingzi cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 21, bingzi

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰遷。雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuchen: transferred. Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on wuchen of the second month to Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 七月庚辰卒。漕運總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day gengchen: died in office. Grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Died in office on gengchen of the seventh month as grain-transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 十月壬申召。江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day renshen: summoned. Jiangnan river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on renshen of the tenth month as Jiangnan River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十二年丁丑

translations.literal: Qianlong year 22, dingchou cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 22, dingchou

sentences.zh: 七月丁未卒。閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day dingwei: died in office. Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Died in office on dingwei of the seventh month as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 七月丁未遷。兩廣總督。未任前，署。十二月癸亥卒。兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day dingwei: transferred. Liangguang governor-general. Before taking office, acting appointment. Twelfth month, day guihai: died in office. Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on dingwei of the seventh month to Liangguang governor-general, acting before formally taking office. Died in office on guihai of the twelfth month as Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 七月辛酉逮。甲子，雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day xinyou: arrested. Day jiazi: Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Arrested on xinyou of the seventh month; on jiazi became Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 正月甲辰遷。漕運總督。

translations.literal: First month, day jiachen: transferred. Grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on jiachen of the first month to grain-transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 正月甲辰居家待罪。江南河道總督。

translations.literal: First month, day jiachen: remained at home awaiting punishment. Jiangnan river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the first month remained at home awaiting punishment as Jiangnan River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 正月甲辰遷。河東河道總督。

translations.literal: First month, day jiachen: transferred. Hedong river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on jiachen of the first month to Hedong River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十三年戊寅

translations.literal: Qianlong year 23, wuyin cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 23, wuyin

sentences.zh: 四月丙子調。署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day bingzi: transferred. Acting Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on bingzi of the fourth month as acting Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十四年己卯裁四川總督，改陝甘總督爲川陝總督，設甘肅總督。

translations.literal: Qianlong year 24, jimao cyclical year: the Sichuan governor-generalship was abolished; the Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general was changed to Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general; the Gansu governor-general was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 24, jimao, the Sichuan governor-general post was abolished, Shaanxi-Gansu was renamed Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general, and a Gansu governor-general was established.

sentences.zh: 正月乙亥卒。陝甘總督。七月乙亥，改川陝總督，甘肅總督。

translations.literal: First month, day yihai: died in office. Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general. Seventh month, day yihai: changed to Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general, Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Died in office on yihai of the first month as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general. On yihai of the seventh month the posts became Sichuan-Shaanxi and Gansu governor-generals.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰遷。署閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day renchen: transferred. Acting Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on renchen of the third month as acting Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午免。湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengwu: excused from office. Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Excused from office on gengwu of the ninth month as Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十五年庚辰裁甘督，復陝甘、四川兩總督。

translations.literal: Qianlong year 25, gengchen cyclical year: the Gansu governor-generalship was abolished; the Shaanxi-Gansu and Sichuan governor-generalships were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 25, gengchen, the Gansu governor-general post was abolished and the separate Shaanxi-Gansu and Sichuan governor-general posts restored.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，改陝甘總督。 改四川總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingxu: changed to Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general. Changed to Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the twelfth month became Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general and Sichuan governor-general respectively.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十六年辛巳

translations.literal: Qianlong year 26, xinsi cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 26, xinsi

sentences.zh: 四月壬辰遷。湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day renchen: transferred. Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on renchen of the fourth month to Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 四月壬辰遷。兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day renchen: transferred. Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on renchen of the fourth month to Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 四月壬辰遷。雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day renchen: transferred. Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on renchen of the fourth month to Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申卒。南河河道總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day wushen: died in office. Southern-river canal governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Died in office on wushen of the third month as Southern Canal River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十七年壬午

translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 27, renwu

translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 28, guiwei

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuxu: dismissed from office. Day renyin: Sichuan governor-general. Still also Shaanxi-Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Dismissed on wuxu of the sixth month; on renyin became Sichuan governor-general while still holding Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉免。湖廣總督。署。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guiyou: excused from office. Huguang governor-general. Acting appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Excused from office on guiyou of the fifth month as Huguang governor-general; acting appointment.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉卒。河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinyou: died in office. Hedong river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Died in office on xinyou of the eleventh month as Hedong River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十九年甲申

translations.literal: Qianlong year 29, jiashen cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 29, jiashen

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌召。署。六月丙午回四川總督。 仍陝甘。

translations.literal: Third month, day renxu: summoned. Acting appointment. Sixth month, day bingwu: returned to Sichuan governor-general. Still also Shaanxi-Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on renxu of the third month in an acting capacity. On bingwu of the sixth month returned to Sichuan governor-general while still holding Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰免。閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen: excused from office. Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Excused from office on jiachen of the sixth month as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰遷。湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen: transferred. Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on jiachen of the sixth month to Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰遷。兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen: transferred. Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on jiachen of the sixth month to Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰遷。雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen: transferred. Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on jiachen of the sixth month to Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥卒。河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dinghai: died in office. Hedong river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Died in office on dinghai of the sixth month as Hedong River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十年乙酉

translations.literal: Qianlong year 30, yiyou cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 30, yiyou

sentences.zh: 三月乙未遷。兩江總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiwei: transferred. Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on yiwei of the third month to Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉憂。署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiyou: mourning leave. Acting Liangguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the sixth month entered mourning leave as acting Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未遷。江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiwei: transferred. Jiangnan river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on yiwei of the third month to Jiangnan River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未遷。河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiwei: transferred. Hedong river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on yiwei of the third month to Hedong River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十一年丙戌

translations.literal: Qianlong year 31, bingxu cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 31, bingxu

sentences.zh: 仍四川。 正月丙戌遷。陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Still also Sichuan. First month, day bingxu: transferred. Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Still holding Sichuan; transferred on bingxu of the first month to Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 正月丙戌遷。湖廣總督。二月壬寅降。湖廣總督。

translations.literal: First month, day bingxu: transferred. Huguang governor-general. Second month, day renyin: demoted. Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on bingxu of the first month to Huguang governor-general. Demoted on renyin of the second month as Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 正月丙戌遷。雲貴總督。

translations.literal: First month, day bingxu: transferred. Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on bingxu of the first month to Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十二年丁亥

translations.literal: Qianlong year 32, dinghai cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 32, dinghai

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅召。仍任兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengyin: summoned. Still held Liangguang governor-general post.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on gengyin of the third month while still serving as Liangguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑召。雲貴總督。署。

translations.literal: Third month, day yichou: summoned. Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general. Acting appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on yichou of the third month as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 七月辛巳遷。河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day xinsi: transferred. Hedong river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred on xinsi of the seventh month to Hedong River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十三年戊子

translations.literal: Qianlong year 33, wuzi cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 33, wuzi

sentences.zh: 八月壬申卒。直隸總督。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renshen: died in office. Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Died in office on renshen of the eighth month as Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 仍四川。 十二月甲遷。陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Still also Sichuan. Twelfth month, day jia: transferred. Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Still holding Sichuan; transferred in the twelfth month on day jia to Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 正月丁未卒。閩浙總督。

translations.literal: First month, day dingwei: died in office. Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Died in office on dingwei of the first month as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子卒。湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiazi: died in office. Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Died in office on jiazi of the twelfth month as Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌陣亡。雲貴總督。暫管。六月壬午降。雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingxu: killed in battle. Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general. Temporarily administered. Sixth month, day renwu: demoted. Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Killed in battle on bingxu of the second month as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; temporarily administered. Demoted on renwu of the sixth month as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未卒。署漕運總督。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiwei: died in office. Acting grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Died in office on jiwei of the twelfth month as acting grain-transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 卒。兼直隸河道總督。

translations.literal: Died in office. Also held Zhili river-works governor-general concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Died in office while also serving concurrently as Zhili River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十四年己丑

translations.literal: Qianlong year 34, jichou cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 34, jichou

sentences.zh: 正月辛卯免兼。雲貴總督。三月丙午降。雲貴總督。十月乙卯革。署雲貴總督。

translations.literal: First month, day xinmao: relieved of concurrent post. Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general. Third month, day bingwu: demoted. Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general. Tenth month, day yimao: dismissed from office. Acting Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao of the first month relieved of his concurrent post as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general. Demoted on bingwu of the third month; dismissed on yimao of the tenth month and made acting Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑免。漕運總督。署。尋卒。補。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yichou: excused from office. Grain-transport governor-general. Acting appointment. Soon died in office. Confirmed appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Excused on yichou of the sixth month as grain-transport governor-general in an acting capacity; soon died in office; post confirmed.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅降。河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiayin: demoted. Hedong river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Demoted on jiayin of the second month as Hedong River Works Governor-General.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十五年庚寅

translations.literal: Qianlong year 35, gengyin cyclical year.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 35, gengyin

sentences.zh: 十月壬午召。署四川總督。 仍陝甘。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day renwu: summoned. Acting Sichuan governor-general. Still also Shaanxi-Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned on renwu of the tenth month as acting Sichuan governor-general while still holding Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 十月辛巳召。署閩浙總督。

translations.idiomatic: Died in office on guihai of the eleventh month as Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.

translations.idiomatic: Summoned on renwu of the first month as Liangguang governor-general.

translations.idiomatic: Dismissed on jiazi of the sixth month as grain-transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑降。直隸總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingchou: demoted. Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Demoted on dingchou of the second month as Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 五月己酉革。兼署兩江總督。六月辛亥兩江總督。

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑降。直隸河道總督。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingchou: demoted. Zhili river-works governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Demoted on dingchou of the second month as Zhili River Works Governor-General.
